summary: Kimi Antonelli carved through the field from 19th on the grid to win at Monza, becoming the first Italian to win his home Grand Prix since 1966. Mid-race contact between title contenders triggered a safety car period that shuffled the order, but Antonelli emerged from the chaos to control the final laps and cross the line ahead of his rivals. The Mercedes driver's victory drastically narrows the championship picture, leaving George Russell's title bid in serious jeopardy while reshaping the campaign's final phase.
